observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same book cover for 'Monster Mission' by Eva Ibbotson.
The cover features a large, dark-feathered bird with a large, pale beak and a single visible eye.
The background is a starry blue sky.
A small white bird is perched on a nest in the foreground.
A quote at the bottom reads: 'This kind of fun will never fail to delight.' — Philip Pullman.
The book appears to be a hardcover edition, with visible wear on the edges and spine.
